runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-21 doesn't set a fine for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline. The passages I retrieved contain no fine or other penalty for missing it.

The memo does set the deadline. Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to responsible AI use and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of its applications. Agencies must use the OMB-provided AI Strategies template and make their strategies public.

My search was a targeted one, not a read of the whole memo, so I can't rule out a penalty elsewhere in it. I found none in the passages that came back.

Passage says agencies must use the OMB template and make strategies public, but the text cuts off after "publicly" with a footnote.
